summary: Concord owns the lane contract, evidence boundary, and provenance record; host-specific lane procedure reaches a dispatch only through the CD-0034 enumerable host instruction surface. Under CD-0246, a lane's generated definition carries the portable engineering method its purpose uses. Under CD-0245 and CD-0246, skills/ admits skills that operate Concord-defined structure or carry portable methods; a worker never depends on a skill for its method. The deferring coverage rows name the host owner.
title: Lane methodology is host-owned and provenance-recorded
